trim_instruction: Mate both factory connector ends, trial-dress with assembly slack, then remove excess from the middle of each lead. Retain enough tail to solder without heating the housings. Join by signal and insulate every joint with heat-shrink before closure. Model locations are packing estimates, not fixed cut lengths. Check continuity and insulation before USB power. Never cut off the original female jumper ends.
